breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification uses 'periodic domain x in [0, 1) with Nx=512 grid points,' which is consistent with the ground truth's periodic grid convention (Nx points, no duplicated endpoint, dx=1/Nx). The contradictory instruction about interpreting Nx as the number of grid points including both endpoints with dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1) was correctly dropped.
